{"path":"/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/silicon_bulk_modulus_trial_0/in.lammps","content":"# LAMMPS Input Script for Silicon Bulk Modulus Calculation
units real
atom_style full
boundary p p p
read_data silicon_structure.data

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style reaxff NULL
pair_coeff * * /potentials/ffield.reax.SiO Si

# Charge equilibration
fix 1 all qeq/reaxff 1 0.0 10.0 1e-6 reax/c

# Minimization settings
min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Apply deformation and run
variable strain equal 1e-06

# Loop over strain modes
label loop
variable i loop 6

if "${i} == 1" then "displace_atoms all move v_strain 0 0"

if "${i} == 3" then "displace_atoms all move 0 0 v_strain"

if "${i} == 5" then "displace_atoms all move v_strain 0 v_strain"
if "${i} == 6" then "displace_atoms all move v_strain v_strain 0"

run 0

next i
jump SELF loop

# Output stress-strain data
thermo_style custom step temp press pxx pyy pzz pyz pxz pxy
thermo 1
"}
